author: CNN
description:
The Supreme Court shook up the national fight over redistricting with a ruling that will make it far harder for voters to challenge future maps for racial discrimination.

With six months to go before the midterm elections, the GOP is racing to redraw district maps. CNN's Manu Raju discusses with his "Inside Politics" panel.

0:00 Trump faces key test as GOP races to redraw maps
2:00 Zeleny: "Unlikely" that Republicans will hold the House
4:33 Special state legislative sessions starting across the South
7:25 How the Congressional map may change by 2028

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#Redistricting #Gerrymandering #News
title: Supreme Court ruling sets off gerrymandering scramble

author: CNN
description:
Commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover and mission specialists Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen discuss their journey to the far side of the moon with Anderson Cooper. "There was a part of us that was left there, I would say, because of what we got to see," says Koch.

0:00 Artemis II crew talk about processing their experience
0:47 How did the crew capture some of the most amazing images of the mission?
2:29 How did it smell when the Navy divers opened the capsule hatch?
4:16 The crew on their decision to honor Reid Wiseman's late wife
5:28 How did Christina Koch compose her remarks after contact was reestablished after the lunar flyby?
8:55 "It's the honor and privilege of a lifetime. It's also the responsibility of a lifetime."

NASA's Artemis II mission in 20 minutes: https://youtu.be/6uOqqPupSyA

#ArtemisII #MoonMission #News
title: Artemis II crew: what it's like to travel 39x the speed of sound

author: CNN
description: A stuffed cat full of marijuana, crab legs with Old Bay seasoning and a basketball overflowing with tobacco. Drones carrying contraband disguised as everyday objects are flying into prison yards across the country. CNN’s Ryan Young goes inside a maximum-security prison in South Carolina to see how they are tracking drones and confiscating prohibited items.
title: The hunt for drones inside prisons

author: CNN
description: Alex Zanardi, the Italian auto racing champion-turned-Paralympic gold medalist, has died at 59. After a 2001 crash that resulted in the amputation of both legs, he shifted to hand cycling and became one of the world’s most accomplished athletes. CNN's Patrick Snell reports. #cnn #news #alexzanardi
title: Remembering Alex Zanardi: From F1 to Paralympic gold
